== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A launcher [[construct]] is a type of specialized puppet used in [[Soulsmithing]] that functions as a container for a specific [[technique]], known as a [[binding]]. Unlike more complex [[constructs]] that might amplify or enhance the power of their internal [[technique]], launchers are considered relatively simple and provide a static output. They essentially serve to house a [[binding]]—such as a [[Striker technique]]—to allow its power to be projected or released over a distance. While they do not gain strength from the user in the way a traditional weapon might, they are highly efficient tools for extending the range of an individual's abilities. These [[constructs]] vary significantly in complexity, quality, and purpose. They can range from basic, single-use items made from [[dead matter]] to highly advanced, multi-[[binding]] devices capable of devastating effects. Some launchers are designed for defense, such as batteries mounted on city walls to protect against massive threats, while others serve offensive roles like cannons or wrist-mounted devices. They are categorized by their power levels, including [[Lowgold]], [[Highgold]], [[Truegold]], [[Underlord]], [[Monarch]], and [[Herald]]-grade. Because they are built using living components and [[dead matter]], their stability and longevity depend heavily on the skill of the [[Forger]]. If a launcher is exposed to essence for too long without being kept in a sealed container, it risks dissolving or snapping upon use.}}

== Reaper ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|[[Lindon]] utilizes launcher [[constructs]] to discharge various weapons during his journey. These devices offer greater efficiency than a standard bow, and they can even be used to propel striker techniques. While navigating certain rooms, he must contend with environments filled with deadly versions of these [[constructs]]. To facilitate his combat, [[Lindon]] is able to retrieve launcher [[constructs]] directly from his [[void space]].}}
